title: Single at a wedding: Virgo, then vs now.
caption: 2016: Virgo hid behind the flowers at the singles table, rearranging them. 2026: Virgo laminated joke name cards, led a conga line in height order and handed Pisces the bouquet. Same table, very different energy. Which seat are you?
